title: These Are Not Defiled With Women

sense.text:
“For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey”: the Son of man is the black Messiah. He “left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.”

Because Christ gave his servants authority, whatever we say the scripture says, that is what it says. Get mad if you want to, call us whatever you want to call us. Esau has no authority over this book; the white man has no authority over this book; the other nations have no authority over this book. Christ gave only the Israelites authority over this book.

That is why we do not debate. Why debate the white man, when the white man cannot repent anyway? And some who call themselves Israelites will not repent either; some were just appointed to die. Whatever we said the Bible said, that is what it said, and we are not going back and forth with anybody.

Some have been around a while and have no loyalty: no loyalty to Messiah, no loyalty to his son, no loyalty to men. Their only loyalty is to their penis. That is the sign of every traitor: a man with no loyalty but to his wife will betray his own brother for the woman. When that is all your loyalty is to, you cannot be trusted.

“Now therefore set thine house in order.” Leadership starts in your household first, not in the church. Leadership starts with the family.

A brother who calls himself a leader but lets a woman get under his skin so bad that he puts hands on her is not a leader. It does not matter what she says, she can talk about your mama. Any man who puts hands on a woman is weak. A true leader knows how to control himself; that is called discipline. How are you going to call yourself a leader with no discipline over your own self, and want to tell other men what to do when you cannot even control your own spirit? Lord willing, one day you will be that leader, but right now you are not.

Setting your house in order does not mean putting hands on the woman. Some think the only way she will listen is by putting hands on her. That makes no sense. Keep your damn filthy hands to yourself.

“And reprove thy people”: if you cannot control yourself, if you have no power over your own house, how are you going to reprove your people? “Comfort such of them as be in trouble”: you cannot comfort anyone with the scriptures when you do not even know the scriptures. If you knew them you would know you do not correct with your hand, you correct with the scriptures. You are so frustrated not knowing the scriptures that you put hands on her, because you do not study. We see you, and we are going to put you out. You put hands, you are out.

“And now renounce corruption”: how are you going to renounce corruption when you yourself are corrupt and your household is corrupt?

Let go of mortal thoughts: sinful thoughts, evil thoughts. When are you going to change? Some have been in this truth one, two, three, four years and are still doing the exact same thing. Some were put out once for putting hands on their wife, and did it again, and are out again. And the sisters who put hands on their husbands, punching their husbands in the face, are out too. None of it will be tolerated.

“Put off now the weak nature.” When are you going to put off the weak nature? Do you even know what repentance is? All the programs, Camp 101, the 300 and the rest, are to change you from a boy to a man. In the world you were a boy, but at IUC we build men, for the betterment of the nation. The nation needs you, but you have to want it; we cannot force it on you.

Some have their body here but their spirit still out in the world. It shows in how they act at home: a good face here, evil to the wife and the children at the house. Some are ready to give up the kingdom for that punani. That is how weak they are.

“These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins.” These are the ones who will not be manipulated by a woman. They stand firm in the word of God, they know how to control themselves, they know what the mission is and why they are here, and they love their people. When you do things that put the work in jeopardy, that is a kind of hatred for your people. This is not about you; it is bigger than you. Some have never been part of anything before, and now they are part of the greatest thing that ever happened on the planet, with no idea what God has prepared for them, and they are ready to throw it all away for some stinking punani. Whatever filthiness you are in, come out of it.

“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth”: they follow Christ, the black Messiah, wherever he goes. You follow by studying, by going out and teaching your people, bringing the people in, teaching the children and teaching your wife, doing what Christ tells you to do. Not by putting hands on her.

Marriage represents Christ and the church, Christ married to Israel. When did Christ ever put hands on the church? Show it in the scripture. The scripture says husbands love your wives the same way Christ loves the church. A man who beats on his wife is not following Christ; he is following his own imagination, following Satan. Some are the devil.

“These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.” You cannot be the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb if you are not doing what the Bible says. That is impossible; the math is not mathing.

precepts.why:
“Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments”: that is the church that was in Sardis. These men did not defile their garments; they were not following the woman. They are the same as those “not defiled with women” in Revelation 14:4.

“And they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.” Now the question is, are you worthy? The only ones who will get the kingdom are those who are worthy of it. Nobody can answer that for you; you have to answer it yourself. Until you get your mind in this Bible like you are supposed to, you are not worthy.

Some keep breaking the law year after year, no matter how many classes come out. The reports show how much adultery and fornication is going on in Israel, wives cheating on husbands, men and women evil-spirited. That says the classes are not taking hold. Some are the devil, taking a seat, and when we catch up to them they will be put out.

sense.text:
The society we live in shows how destroyed we are as a people: a wife who passed off twins as her husband's for twelve years, a woman with seven children by seven men, a mother who left her young daughters alone for days to fly to Miami. Some of us are stupid, black people are stupid; not all black people, but some of us. And some of you will lose the kingdom for a woman like that. We are destroyed as a people, a broken people; some of us are at the point of no return. And who is going to fix it? The white man and the other nations love stuff like that. T.D. Jakes cannot change it, Creflo Dollar cannot change it. We, the men, are the last hope of our people. But you cannot fix this if your mind is on coochie all the time.

“For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last”: that is us, brothers. “As it were appointed to death”: by taking this charge, this job, we are going to die for it, and we have to prepare ourselves to die for it. A real prophet, a real leader, does not choose his destiny; his destiny was picked for him before he was even born. Some of us are destined to die for this, some to be tortured, some to go to jail. This is going to get done with you or without you; you have to choose a side.

“For we are made a spectacle unto the world”: we are the most hated people on the planet Earth, especially the Israelite. Even our own people hate us: your wife, your children, your father, your mother hate your guts. So what have you got to lose? You are already hated. Take up your cross and walk. You have to make up your own mind what you want to do.

She hates her children, she hates her own people, she hates herself, and in her mind she does nothing wrong: no remorse, zero accountability. Those are the women some want to lose the kingdom for. Only the Bible can change a mindset like that. So there is no time to play games: you are either all in, or you are out; you cannot have one foot in and one foot out.

“Give me any plague, but the plague of the heart: and any wickedness, but the wickedness of a woman.” Nothing is worse than the wickedness of a woman. You cannot be more loyal to her than to Messiah, knowing she can betray you any day. Yet some are ready to lose the whole kingdom for her. That is a simping spirit, and there is nothing worse than the spirit of a simp.

He is ready to take all of it: “any affliction, but the affliction from them that hate me: and any revenge, but the revenge of enemies.” There is “no head above the head of a serpent” and “no wrath above the wrath of an enemy.” With all of that he can survive, but the wickedness of a woman, nothing is worse.

“I had rather dwell with a lion and a dragon, than to keep house with a wicked woman.” A lion does not negotiate with you; his mindset is to hunt you and kill you. A dragon does not negotiate either; dragon fire is not regular fire, it turns you to charcoal. He is saying, put me in the midst of a dragon, and I might survive that. But the wickedness of a woman, I am not going to survive that. It is worse.

“The wickedness of a woman changeth her face, and darkeneth her countenance”: that is the dark spirit, the evil spirit. Some of these sisters are mean-spirited, and those are your wives. Are you going to lose the kingdom for her?

“Her husband shall sit among his neighbours; and when he heareth it shall sigh bitterly.” That is the brother sitting in the midst of us when someone tells him his wife came home again, and he says, again? What did she do this time? That is a sad thing.

That is why single brothers must be very careful who they marry. The woman you end up with plays a major part in your walk in this truth. Mighty men have fallen because of a woman: men who drew the biggest crowds when they stood up to teach, but could not control the wife. One woman will drain the spirit out of you. Like Dracula bites you and sucks the blood, she will bite you and suck the spirit out of you, a spiritual vampire. Some sisters are not here to change their lives; they are here to destroy you, and they will if you let them.

Sisters do the same: some with mad work in this truth marry a knucklehead, told plainly not to marry that brother, and within two years he is putting hands on her. A man knows another man. When God created Adam, he took Eve and brought her to Adam: God was saying, you do not know how to choose. That is why God put a father figure in your life.

There is no nation without the black family. Marriage among our people is down to 34%, from 85% when we were growing up, and no culture in the history of humankind has risen without family at the center of it. The nation starts with the black family; there is no nation on the planet ever built without a man and a woman. To build the nation of Israel, the family has to be set in place. That is why Bishop asks, when you first come in, are you married? Bring your wife, bring your children. You cannot be a leader and be somebody else at home, abusing your wife and your children.

“If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband, then they shall both of them die.” What is the judgment? Death. Today we cannot put anybody to death, but God can bring any kind of judgment: disease, getting hit by a car, all types of judgment out here. Some have secret sin, doing it where nobody knows, and wonder why they are not growing in the truth and why the car and the truck broke down and everything is chaos. Brother, what are you in the midst of? God is bringing judgment against you.

A brother married a sister; she left, went back to her ex, they divorced, and the brother went back and slept with her again. You are a simp, and God will bring judgment against you for that.

“Both the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou put away evil from Israel.” Today the way we put away evil is that you have to go. We put you out.

precepts.why:
Knowing the law and applying it are two different things. Some are quick with the precepts and know where the verse is, but do not apply it. Do not be a hearer only; be a doer.

“If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s”: the sister is gone and sleeping with another man. “Shall he return unto her again?” Shall that first husband return to her? “Shall not that land be greatly polluted?” The land he is talking about is the coochie: it is polluted. That is what God is saying, put plainly so it can get through your heads. It has been polluted; now it stinks like fish.

A brother who goes back to that shows where his loyalty is, and a man like that cannot be trusted, because he will betray his brothers for that.

This is where the law of Jeremiah 3:1 comes from. It is not read to push divorce, but to show the law says the same thing Jeremiah said.

“When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement.” “When she is departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.” And if the latter husband does not like her either and writes her a bill of divorcement, “or if the latter husband die”, “Her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled.” The first husband cannot go back to her; the land is polluted. She is defiled, and the brother who goes and sleeps with her is defiled too, and has to be put out.

Brothers get counsel after counsel: stop taking her phone calls, change your number, do not talk to her, do you not see she is trying to set you up? If a woman leaves you for another man and there are no children, communication is cut. She wants to go to the doctor? I don’t give a damn; let the man she is sleeping with take her; she is no longer your responsibility. Why is she still in your car, why are you going to her house? You dumb ass cannot see the setup? That is how stupid you are, and you call yourself a leader. That is a lack of discipline, and you are willing to lose the kingdom for that: the king of simps.

sense.text: “That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.” This is the woman who flatters with her words: she tells you you look like Denzel, but you look like Buckwheat.
“And beheld among the simple ones”: some of you are simple. “A young man void of understanding”: the law, the Bible, has gone out the window; the Bible is under the bed.

“He went the way to her house, In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night.” Today he drove to the house. The brother thinks nobody sees him: it is dark, he parks his car a couple of blocks away so no brother or sister driving by sees it, parks out of the streetlight, puts his hoodie on and walks. That is a simple brother.

“There met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.” “She is loud and stubborn”: that big mouth. Some of your wives fit what we are reading. You cannot tell her a damn thing; she is always right, never wrong. She talks so much she wears you down until you have no spirit left. Why are you always with the brothers, always at so-and-so’s house breaking down scriptures? She drops the baby in his lap while he is in the circle breaking scripture with the brothers, and he tolerates it, because she will not give him none. That is simple.

“Her feet abide not in her house”: she is in everybody’s business except hers. Her house is stinking, but she is in another sister’s house. “Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner”: she will have you cornered to destroy you. She knows a simp is coming around that corner.

“So she caught him, and kissed him”: she caught you because you are a simp. “I have peace offerings with me”: the peace offering is food. Shalom, I cooked today, come by and get a plate. She is setting you up, and you fall right for it: I am just going to break scripture with her, she is a good sister. She might be a good sister, but you are an idiot falling into her trap. Sisters have kept a thing with a brother secret for months and years, watching whether he talks to other sisters, and then let everybody know. She set him up, and some keep falling for it because they do not listen when the brothers see the spirit and warn them: brother, I don’t think it’s a good idea; I’m trying to help you, dumb ass.

“Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee”: the sweet talk. I have been waiting for a husband a long time and finally found him. How much money did you make last year, what job do you do, what car do you have? Brothers have gone and bought a BMW to impress the woman, and she still left his dumb ass.

“I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt. I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon. Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning.” The bed smells good, with the fine linen of Egypt, where the best linen comes from. It sounds like a poem, like a love song she is singing to the brother, and he is just standing in front of her listening, gone. She has got him.

precepts.why:
Solomon is giving his own experience. “By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.” That is you, brothers. Like the young man in the twilight in Proverbs 7, some brothers will miss Camp 101 and miss MOV just to make time to please the strange woman. The prince is persuaded through the words, through the bread she prepared, the linen of Egypt and the perfumed bed: she is trying to persuade you with the food.

You are supposed to be strong, remembering the commandments, ten toes down and loyal to the Lord, but you let the woman defile your understanding. We are not supposed to be like that.

Solomon is telling you out of his own experience what not to do. By means of that woman “a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.” You are being hunted, brothers, hunted by the clean-up woman, hunted for your soul. Do not be defiled.

sense.text:
“A wicked woman abateth the courage, maketh an heavy countenance and a wounded heart”: she takes all your strength and makes you weak. That is why single brothers must be very careful who they marry.

No woman is worth losing the kingdom over. She cannot be first in your life: the Most High God comes first. Your first loyalty is to the Most High God, not to the woman and not to your kids. And no woman is worth going to jail for; when you put your hands on her, you are going to jail.

Walk away. You should not be standing there arguing back and forth with a woman; any man who does that is a woman too, because women argue with women and men do not argue with women. What are you winning? Is there a prize? Some are like a ticking time bomb, waiting for someone to say something so they can explode. Part of repentance is change. It is only going to get under your skin if you allow it. If you know she is going to say something to set you off, walk away, go sit in the car, and let her go at it with the wall. It is not worth being put out of the congregation.

“A woman that will not comfort her husband in distress maketh weak hands and feeble knees”: the sister who will not comfort her husband. After a twelve- or fourteen-hour shift nobody wants to deal with that. Some were told not to marry her, and that is what they picked.

Sirach is the book that gets our people listening in the street. Every time it is read, a crowd gathers asking what book that is, because it is so plain and people can relate to it.

This class is for the brothers to learn how to control themselves, and to know their loyalty is to the Most High, not to the woman.

“Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth”: mortify means subdue, suppress. Control yourself, brothers. Everybody on this earth wants to kill you and hates your guts. “Fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry”: those are the members. They are things we have in us, and we have to suppress them and remove them.

Everybody in this room is fighting with something. The problem is some have discipline and some do not. If you have been fighting the same anger for seven, eight, nine, ten years in this room, something is wrong; the scripture is not clicking and you are not growing. You know these scriptures already; the bishops, the deacons and the captains have gone through them. Then why are you not doing it? Your spirit is not taking hold of the scriptures, and you need to find out why.

“To depart from wickedness is a thing pleasing to the Lord”: to forsake sin, turn your back on sin, is pleasing to God. God loves that. Remove yourself from your sin.

“And to forsake unrighteousness is a propitiation.” The unrighteous are not going to get the kingdom. Propitiation is like atonement: the action of propitiating or appeasing a god. Forsaking unrighteousness is pleasing and appeasing God. No unrighteous man is going to get the kingdom, brothers.

We want to believe we are not dealing with a bunch of boys but with men, yet some are still in that boy mentality.

“But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints.” As you repent, do not let those sins be found among you again, because those are the same things you were fighting and in the midst of when you were in the world. Some came into the truth and are still in the midst of the same thing. It is like a pig with a bow tie: put a bow tie on the pig and it goes right back outside to the dirt. The scripture calls it a dog going back to his own vomit. You cannot be like that. Be ye men, brothers. We are the army of the living God.
